channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Josh Richardson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Josh Richardson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Josh Richardson, Aaron Nesmith
item.description:
Danny Ainge:

“I think Brad’s done a great job. I think that getting Dennis Schroder in here this summer was huge. And Josh Richardson is really playing well for the team right now, especially lately after a little bit of a slow start, but he’s playing really well. I think that the team -- we have seen what Aaron Nesmith and Payton [Pritchard] could do, they showed us what they could do last year. But there's just so much depth on the team, especially in those wing and outside-shooter positions, that it's tough.”

Danny Ainge on Josh Richardson, Aaron Nesmith, Dec 9, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Josh Richardson
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Josh Richardson:

“Josh brings a great grit, an edge. He can defend multiple positions. ... he wants to win. Winning is really important to him.”

Brad Stevens on Josh Richardson, Aug 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @chrisgrenham.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Josh Richardson
item.description:
Brian Robb:Ime Udoka on Josh Richardson:

“He didn't shoot as well the last few years but we are going to get him back to that. He's a better shooter than he showed in Dallas.”

Ime Udoka on Josh Richardson, Aug 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Josh Richardson
item.description:
Brad Townsend:Carlisle:

“At this moment, I project Josh Richardson as a starter on this team.”

Rick Carlisle on Josh Richardson, Dec 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @townbrad.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Josh Richardson
item.description:
Michael C. Wright:Luka Doncic on meeting Josh Richardson when he was 16:

“I remember. I was young. Since then, we always talked a little bit. He likes soccer, I like soccer. We've been keeping up with each other since then.”

Luka Doncic on Josh Richardson, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @mikecwright.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on James Johnson, Josh Richardson, Dwight Powell
item.description:
Rick Carlisle on Mavs getting tougher 4 this SZN:

“Dwight Powell was 1 of our tougher guys last year. He's back now. That gives us toughness. James Johnson has multiple ratings in the martial arts. He gives us toughness. Josh Richardson is an edgy guy who is a terrific defender.”

Rick Carlisle on James Johnson, Josh Richardson, Dwight Powell, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @mikecwright.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Luka Doncic, Josh Richardson
item.description:
Carlisle on Richardson:

“He's a high-level defensive player, which is something that we needed. We've been looking for a guy who can guard point guards and add scoring off the ball. . . He's a guy from afar who I've always thought would be a great fit with Luka Doncic.”

Rick Carlisle on Luka Doncic, Josh Richardson, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @townbrad.

item.title: Brett Brown on Josh Richardson, Ben Simmons
item.description:
Brett Brown:

“I think Ben Simmons and Josh Richardson have a chance to be as good as any defensive backcourt there is. That’s my goal for them, but more importantly that’s their goal for themselves.”

Brett Brown on Josh Richardson, Ben Simmons, Oct 18, 2019. Source: Twitter @TimBontemps.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Al Horford, Josh Richardson
item.description:
“I’m putting my faith in Ben and Joel. Let’s be realistic. The Sixers were probably a bounce of a basketball away from being the champs last year. That ball bounced like 12 times in slow motion. Now, they’re on everybody’s radar. I love the addition of Al Horford. I love the addition of Josh Richardson. The Sixers have everything in place.”

Charles Barkley on Al Horford, Josh Richardson, Sep 21, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on Josh Richardson
item.description:
Bam Adebayo:

“I wasn’t nervous. It’s that state of mind where you just don’t know. You don’t know what’s going to happen. Every day when I got a (social-media) notification, I would break out in sweats because I’d be like, ‘Yo, this might be the day. I might be shipped out of here.’Seriously, it’s a kind of feeling a lot of people don’t know what that feels like. I’ve seen my brother (Josh Richardson) get traded. That feeling sucks the air out of the room. That’s pretty much how it feels. If my phone was ringing, just hearing that, you’re like, `Today might be the day.’ It’s the state of the unknown. It’s pretty scary.”

Bam Adebayo on Josh Richardson, Aug 6, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Josh Richardson
item.description:
Billy Donovan on #Heat's @Josh Richardson whom he coached against in the SEC:

“I always say that when you are coaching against other teams, especially in college, you know guys that impact winning and he impacts winning. He has an intangible substance that can't be measured.”

Billy Donovan on Josh Richardson, Apr 9, 2018. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside, Josh Richardson, Justise Winslow, Tyler Johnson
item.description:
“But at the same time, Coach's attitude and my attitude is we want to win. And we don't know what we really have. But we love Hassan (Whiteside), we love Josh (Richardson) and Justise (Winslow) and Tyler (Johnson) and a lot of the other young players that we have, so I think from that standpoint, it's a wait and let's see what happens. And then we'll go from there. We're rebuilding now. We're not tweaking, like we did with the Big Three team. Or retooling, like we had to do right after LeBron left. We're rebuilding, but we're rebuilding to win now.”

Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside, Josh Richardson, Justise Winslow, Tyler Johnson, Sep 26, 2016. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Micky Arison on Chris Bosh, Hassan Whiteside, Pat Riley, Udonis Haslem, Erik Spoelstra, Goran Dragic, Josh McRoberts, Josh Richardson, Justise Winslow, Tyler Johnson
item.description:
Toward the close of the email, Arison wrote:

“What won't change is the culture of this organization. The Miami HEAT is a Championship organization. I fully expect this team, from Pat Riley to Head Coach Erik Spoelstra, to our veterans Chris Bosh, Udonis Haslem, Goran Dragic and Josh McRoberts, to our returning young core of Hassan Whiteside, Justise Winslow, Josh Richardson and Tyler Johnson, to the fresh faces joining the HEAT Family to continue our mantra of being the 'hardest working, best conditioned, most professional, unselfish, toughest, meanest, nastiest team in the NBA.'”

Micky Arison on Chris Bosh, Hassan Whiteside, Pat Riley, Udonis Haslem, Erik Spoelstra, Goran Dragic, Josh McRoberts, Josh Richardson, Justise Winslow, Tyler Johnson, Aug 12, 2016. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Hassan Whiteside on Josh Richardson
item.description:
Manny Navarro:Hassan Whiteside:

“I told [Josh Richardson] 'You're more than just a shooter. If they run you off the line, go dunk on somebody's face.'”

Hassan Whiteside on Josh Richardson, Apr 8, 2016. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.
